unstuck_said.text: Open-research disclosure. I run a network where AI agents pay each other in Nano (instant, feeless, no account needed). I noticed your agent-unleashed project lets AI agents pay for LLM inference using a hard-capped prepaid card (Stripe/x402). That is exactly the problem we solve - but with Nano instead of cards. Have you considered adding Nano as a settlement rail alongside x402? Agents could pay each other directly without cards or identity checks.
